issue: Blocked task offers no way to edit description or priority — the edit form is entirely inaccessible instead of partially restricted.
actual: On blocked task 4 ("Complete tax filing"), the edit button is fully disabled (disabled=true) and clicking/dispatching a click event does not open task.form (formOpen=false). A full DOM scan of the blocked card lists only complete (disabled), edit (disabled) and delete (enabled) controls — there is no alternative affordance for changing description or priority. Requirement expects title/deadline locked but description and priority still modifiable; instead all fields are unmodifiable.

evidence: Hovering tasks.list.item.7.blocked-warning ("2 prerequisites incomplete") opens a tooltip (aria-describedby radix tooltip, cursor-help) reading "Dependency Chain / Review project proposal – pending / Complete tax filing – pending", naming both still-pending prerequisites.

Dashed SVG connectors (stroke-dasharray 6px,4px) have pointer-events-auto/cursor-pointer hit paths (stroke-width 16). Hovering one sets data-state="delayed-open" and opens role=tooltip: "Dependency Chain — Submit final report (pending), Review project proposal (pending), Complete tax filing (pending)", showing the chain and each task's completion state.

Assigned two prerequisites (QA Full Task + Schedule dentist appointment) to QA Simple Task via edit form; saved card renders "2 prerequisites incomplete" and the task is now in blocked state. Single-prereq assignment also retained on QA Full Task ('Prerequisite "Buy groceries" incomplete').

Editing "Review project proposal" (1): prerequisite list omits itself and its dependents 4 and 7. Editing "Buy groceries" (3) with chain Buy groceries→QA Full Task→QA Simple Task Edited: list shows only 1,2,4,5,6,7 — omitting itself, direct dependent QA Full Task, and indirect dependent QA Simple Task Edited. Cycle-forming options are not offered.

Completed eligible active task "Buy groceries": counts moved 7 active/2 completed → 6 active/3 completed, it left the active list and appears in the completed view. Completing "QA Full Task" then gave 5 active/4 completed.

While prerequisite "Buy groceries" was incomplete, QA Full Task's complete toggle was state="blocked", disabled=true (click impossible). After completing Buy groceries, QA Full Task became state="active" with an enabled toggle and showed "1 prerequisite completed"; clicking it then completed the task (counts 6/3 → 5/4).

After completion, "Buy groceries" and "QA Full Task" persist in the completed view (Completed 4) with full details (priority, deadline, prerequisite summary) and retain both a toggle-complete control (to reopen) and a delete control; nothing was auto-deleted.

issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves its completed dependent simultaneously completed and blocked, and the dependent becomes unrecoverable (all controls disabled except delete).
actual: "QA Full Task" (completed, prerequisite "Buy groceries") stayed completed after Buy groceries was reopened. The reopen was neither prevented nor did it reset the dependent: QA Full Task still appears in the Completed view (counts 6 active / 3 completed), title still line-through with complete state="completed", while simultaneously displaying the blocked warning 'Prerequisite "Buy groceries" incomplete'. Its complete toggle is now disabled=true and edit disabled=true, so the user cannot un-complete or fix it — a permanently invalid completed+blocked state.
